comparison.result: All 984 corresponding relative files have equal SHA-256 and byte counts; both full inventories have the same stable digest.

limitations: Only the two listed mug directories were compared. No duplicate inference is made for other asset roots.
SHA-256 equality is the comparison criterion. File modes, ownership, timestamps, extended attributes and empty directories are outside the digest scope.
Identical bytes do not establish shared licensing, upstream authorship, equivalent task semantics, interchangeable path identities or permission to delete a copy.
Runtime code selects the two task-specific directories separately; saved scene fingerprints preserve original resource paths. Historical or external consumers are not fully enumerated.

method.enumeration: Recursively enumerate all Path.rglob(*) entries for which is_file() is true. These scanned trees have no symlink entries. Use each file path relative to its compared mug directory with POSIX separators. Compare the entire two relative-file path sets, not only their intersection.
method.file_hash: SHA-256 of complete file bytes, streamed in 1,048,576-byte chunks.
method.report_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, 2-space indentation, sorted object keys and deterministic arrays.
method.stable_digest: Sort all relative POSIX file paths by Unicode lexical order. For each path append UTF-8(path), one NUL byte (0x00), the 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters of SHA-256(file bytes), and one LF byte (0x0a). Concatenate these records without a header or any extra bytes; SHA-256 the concatenation. The same relative path and content list must produce the same digest. Digest excludes the compared directory prefix, enabling equality comparison.

path_coupling_evidence.meaning: mug_flip and mug_tree have separate task-specific roots, dynamic variants and model.xml consumers.
Resource fingerprint identity includes canonical path as well as SHA-256.
Restore checks the complete resource fingerprint; relocating an identical file can break recorded scenes.

scope.comparison: Every relative regular-file path and complete file SHA-256 in both task mug directories, recursively; not a broad duplicate scan.
scope.purpose: Content identity evidence only; retain both directories. No move, removal, replacement, symlink, or runtime change is authorized.
